sentences.en: For many people that was the realization of a dream.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，那是梦想成真的时刻。

sentences.en: I came to the realization too late to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 我意识到这一点的时候已经太晚了，无法产生影响。

sentences.en: None of these plans ever come anywhere near realization.
sentences.zh: 这些计划中的任何一个都没有接近实现。
